name: Kettlebell goblet squat
definition: Stand holding one kettlebell at the chest with both hands. Lower by bending the hips and knees while retaining the front-held load, then stand.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Stand holding one kettlebell at the chest with both hands.
value.movement: Lower by bending the hips and knees while retaining the front-held load, then stand.
value.finish: Return to standing without changing the kettlebell position.
value.range_of_motion: Repeatable self-selected squat depth; kettlebell remains close to the chest.
